description: Shows where an annual taxable income ranks among Australians, using the ATO taxation statistics behind the paycalculator.com.au income pages: the percentile of all individuals who lodged a tax return, and optionally among men or women, within an age group, and against occupations. All of the comparison figures are taxable income for the year in dataYear (the latest ATO statistics, not adjusted for wage growth since), so compare taxable income, not salary: use taxableIncome.total.annual from calculate_pay when it is available. Cite the dataYear and sources when presenting the results.

age.description: Age in years: also rank the income within the age group (e.g. 30 to 34).

gender.description: Also rank the income among men or women only (and within the age group, when age is given). Only when the user gives it.

occupation.description: Occupation to compare with, in a few words (e.g. "nurse", "electrician", "software programmer"). Up to 5 matching ATO occupations (ANZSCO) are returned.

name: compare_income

gender.description: Present when the age group figures are for one gender.

medianIncome.description: Median taxable income of the age group.

averageTax.description: Average net tax paid in the band.

female.description: Share of the band who are women (%).

male.description: Share of the band who are men (%).

people.description: Number of individuals in the percentile band.

dataYear.description: Financial year of the ATO statistics, e.g. "2023-24".

medianIncome.description: Median taxable income of men or women.

percentile.description: Percentile among men or women only.

incomeRange.description: The taxable income range of that percentile band.

medianIncome.description: Median taxable income of all individuals (half earn less).

occupations.description: Occupations matching the search, specific occupations first. Empty when nothing matches.

difference.description: The income minus the average income: positive when the income is higher.

female.description: Occupation groups only: share who are women (%).

group.description: The occupation group it belongs to. Absent when the match is a whole occupation group.

male.description: Occupation groups only: share who are men (%).

medianIncome.description: Occupation groups only: median taxable income (the average of the medians of its occupations).

occupationsMatchAllWords.description: False when no occupation title has every word of the search and the list is the closest matches - check with the user which fits, rather than assuming.

percentile.description: Percentile (1 to 100) among all individuals who lodged a tax return: the income is in the Nth percentile band, so roughly N% earn less.

title: Compare income
